# Generated store queries with no production caller.
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS SEPARATELY. Phase 20.1's reachability guard runs
# x/tools/cmd/deadcode, which by design does NOT report dead functions in
# GENERATED files. internal/store/gen is generated, so the entire store
# layer was a blind spot — and that is exactly where B42 hid: nothing in
# production ever called UpsertSyncSubscription, so no entity was ever
# subscribed to any route and the whole ESI sync engine had nothing to do.
#
# Same contract as allowlist.txt: a new uncalled query fails the guard, and
# so does an entry here that has gained a caller. This file should SHRINK.

# B42 — the sync engine has no subscription creator; NOTHING is ever scheduled
ListRecentSyncRuns
SetSyncNoCacheOptIn
SetSyncSubscriptionEnabled
SnoozeSyncSubscription
UpsertSyncSubscription

# B24 — §4.9 webhook endpoint configuration surface
CreateWebhookEndpoint
ListWebhookEndpointsForUser
RevokeWebhookEndpoint

# B26 — RBAC mutation and resolution surface
GetRole
GetUserByMainCharacterID
ListEffectivePermissions
ListPermissions
SetUserActive

# B29 — Governor 2's error budget is never incremented or reset
IncrementErrorBudget
ResetErrorBudgetWindow

# B25 — alert routing, channels and the unknown-type boards
CountAlertTypesByDomain
CreateAlertRoutingRule
GetAlertType
ListAlertChannels
ListAlertEventsForCoalesceKeySince
ListAlertTypes
ListRecentAlertEvents
ListUnparseableCharacterNotifications

# B30 — route handlers that are never dispatched, and their readers

# B35 — TeamSpeak identity linking

# HOUSEKEEPING THAT NEVER RUNS — rows accumulate forever
